title: Mission (Im)Possible: Towards Autonomous Discovery of Autopilot Logic Flaws in Open-Source Drone Frameworks
abstract: arXiv:2610.19566v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous drones are increasingly deployed in safety-critical tasks, yet their autopilot software can still contain subtle logic flaws that lead to unsafe behaviors. These flaws are difficult to discover with existing techniques because they often depend on semantic relationships across modules, commands, and runtime state, and rarely manifest as crashes or detectable failures. With recent advances in LLMs, we observe that, when equipped with essential domain knowledge and carefully crafted context, LLMs demonstrate strong capabilities in understanding the high-level semantics of autopilot systems, making them suitable for logic flaw discovery. However, LLMs are limited by their context and can be biased to the vulnerabilities frequently occurs in training dataset, while logic flaws often require higher-level semantic bug oracles to identify their existence. translated_title: 使命（不）可能：面向开源无人机框架中自动驾驶仪逻辑缺陷的自主发现
translated_abstract: 摘要：自主无人机正日益被部署于安全关键任务中，然而其自动驾驶仪软件仍可能包含细微的逻辑缺陷，从而导致不安全的行为。这类缺陷难以通过现有技术发现，因为它们往往依赖于模块、命令和运行时状态之间的语义关系，并且很少表现为崩溃或其他可检测的故障。随着大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展，我们观察到，当配备必要的领域知识和精心构建的上下文时，LLM在理解自动驾驶系统的高级语义方面展现出强大的能力，使其适用于逻辑缺陷的发现。然而，LLM受限于其上下文窗口，并且容易偏向于训练数据集中频繁出现的漏洞类型，而逻辑缺陷的识别通常需要更高级别的语义缺陷判定器。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了Impossible Mission Finder（IMF），一个多智能体
tldr: 本文提出了IMF（Impossible Mission Finder）框架，利用配备领域知识和精心构建上下文的多智能体LLM系统，结合高级语义缺陷判定器，自主发现开源无人机自动驾驶仪软件中难以通过传统方法检测的细微逻辑缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper presents IMF (Impossible Mission Finder), a multi-agent LLM-based framework that autonomously discovers subtle logic flaws in open-source drone autopilot software by equipping LLMs with essential domain knowledge, carefully crafted context, and high-level semantic bug oracles.
